observations: All 62 full-resolution stills and 40 sixteen-frame strips inspected for final video SHA. No prior-image carry-forward.

Headline mask entrances, moving panel entry crops, overlapping fan-card edges/labels and short source-population frames are intentional. No unintended text clipping or blank transition frames found.
Blender editable/native distinction, actual preset/sculpt/history/save/export actions and external MCP changes retain authentic source order and caption limits.
No exposed credentials or personal filesystem paths in reviewed images. Imported material approximations remain visible and documented.
